The ''' Cularin Office of Public Safety''', often known as just the '''Office of Public Safety''' or just the '''OPS''', was a law enforcement agency in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. [[Ezra Du'Re]] worked for it. Members of it arrested [[Echari Di'San]] after he was accused of the murder of [[Rysko Barnt]] in the [[Cantina Oceana]] on [[Dorumaa]].
